description: This file defines a custom database driver class ADODB_mssqlpo that extends the ADODB_mssql class to support a portable version of MSSQL with a custom concatenation operator ('||' instead of '+'). It also includes a recordset class extension ADORecordset_mssqlpo. The file is part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer library and modifies certain SQL behavior for MSSQL.

classes.name: ADODB_mssqlpo
classes.description: A custom driver class for MSSQL that replaces '||' with '+' in SQL statements to support portable SQL syntax.

classes.name: ADORecordset_mssqlpo
classes.description: A recordset class extending ADORecordset_mssql for the 'mssqlpo' database type.

methods.name: PrepareSP
methods.description: Prepares a stored procedure call, replacing '||' with '+' in the SQL statement before initialization.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a query after replacing '||' with '+' in the SQL statement.
